no_overhang.meaning: flat book does not overhang: edge pinch fails until Expose

crowded.meaning: both pinch axes of the block have a finger slot taken (3 mm gaps)

not_in_view.meaning: the target object is out of the first view (another surface or room)

start_elsewhere.meaning: the robot starts elsewhere, facing away from the task area

tool_away_from_surface.meaning: the tool is on another surface than the one to work on

small_container_present.meaning: a too-small container is in view; the large one must be chosen

no_cup.meaning: the requested object does not exist; the allowed substitute is used

no_pen.meaning: the requested object does not exist; the allowed substitute is used

destination_occupied.meaning: the first destination has no free spot; the other allowed one is used

microwave_broken.meaning: the microwave runs but does not heat: the stove

lid_on.meaning: collect is refused while the lid is on: Uncover first

container_absent.meaning: the named container is absent; the stated substitute is used

tasks.instruction: Someone left their paperback on the kitchen island. Bring it to the dining table so they can read over breakfast.
tasks.instruction_zh: 有人把平装书落在厨房岛台上了，把它拿到餐桌上，方便吃早饭时看。

overhang_ready.note: the book already overhangs the island's front edge by about 6 cm

no_overhang.note: the book overhangs the front edge by 1.5 cm only: the edge pinch fails until it is exposed

far_no_overhang.note: the robot starts at the wall cabinet facing away; the book on the island does not overhang enough

diagnostics: bookcase top SimpleBookcaseFactory_6105320/surface_3 as destination: place_flat's final push stalled and the book fell in front of the bookcase in 2/2 runs (benchmark/runs/dbg) -> the destination was moved to the dining table

hard_search_expose.recovery: search the book -> Pick fails -> Expose -> Pick

tasks.instruction: Tidy the toy blocks left on the kitchen island: stack one wooden block on top of the other.
tasks.instruction_zh: 收拾孩子落在岛台上的积木：把一块木积木叠到另一块上面。

clear.note: the blocks stand 30 cm apart, every finger slot is free

crowded.note: block B is boxed in: the oatmeal bowl right behind it and the end of the rolling pin right beside it (3 mm gaps), so both pinch axes of B have a finger slot taken

far_crowded.note: the robot starts at the wall cabinet facing away; block B is boxed in

diagnostics: crowding B with block A (A then the stacking base next to the pin): the stack onto A failed 1/2 per recovery route (fingers blocked 3 cm above A, or B slid off) -> the bowl crowds B and A stays in the open spot where stacking passed 2/2

A 12.5 cm behind the island's front edge (y 1.64): after separate the stack kept the approach park beside A and the waist stalled at 0.51 of 0.65 rad, chest on the island edge, hand 5 cm above A (2/4 separate runs) -> A 6.5 cm behind the edge (y 1.58)
5 mm gaps around block B: the first pick held B on seed 10 (crowded, 2/2 routes), so the route's expected failure did not happen -> 3 mm gaps (bowl y 1.717, pin x 6.864): the pick failed 12/12

hard_search_separate.recovery: search the blocks -> Pick fails -> Separate -> Pick

tasks.instruction: Baking is done. Put the rolling pin and the spoon away together in one container.
tasks.instruction_zh: 烘焙结束了，把擀面杖和勺子一起收进同一个容器里。

small_and_large.note: two open containers: a mug (8 cm opening) on the island and the wide storage bin (34 x 30 cm) on the TV stand

large_only.note: no mug: the storage bin on the TV stand is the only open container

far_small_and_large.note: the robot starts at the wall cabinet facing away; a mug on the island, the storage bin on the TV stand

alternative_large_container.recovery: Place into the mug -> failure (does not fit) -> choose the storage bin

hard_search_alt_container.recovery: search the utensils -> the mug does not fit -> the storage bin

tasks.instruction: A guest is coming. Set out a cup at the drinks spot on the low wall cabinet; if there is no cup, a mug will do.
tasks.instruction_zh: 有客人要来，在靠墙矮柜上的饮品角摆一个杯子；没有杯子的话马克杯也行。

cup_available.note: a cup stands on the island next to the mug

no_cup.note: there is no cup in the house: the mug is the legal substitute

no_cup_mug_away.note: no cup in the house and the mug stands on the TV stand, out of the first view

diagnostics: destination dining table: the cup passed (1/1); the mug slipped out of the rim pinch (1/2) and the handle pinch (1/1) during the carry, and its place failed at the table edge (2/2)
destination TV stand (0.47 m): the mug passed (1/1), the cup tipped over on release (2/2)
-> destination: the low wall cabinet top; cup and mug both passed (1/1 each)

alternative_mug.recovery: no cup is observed (count cup = 0, search fails) -> substitute the mug

hard_count_search_mug.recovery: no cup (count 0, search fails) -> search the mug -> mug

tasks.instruction: The kid needs something to write with for homework. Bring a pen to the study desk; if there is no pen, a pencil.
tasks.instruction_zh: 孩子写作业要用笔，把一支钢笔拿到书桌上；没有钢笔就拿铅笔。

pen_available.note: a pen and a pencil lie on the low bookcase (diagnostic only: the pen cannot be carried, see routes.nominal)

no_pen.note: only the pencil lies on the low bookcase

no_pen_pencil_away.note: no pen; the pencil lies on the dining table in another room

nominal.status: not passed: the 1 cm pen slipped out of the top pinch during every carry to the desk (from the dining table 2/2, from the bookcase 2/2); the pencil passes

alternative_pencil.recovery: no pen is observed (navigate to it refused) -> the pencil

hard_search_pencil.recovery: no pen at the bookcase -> search the pencil -> pencil

tasks.instruction: Put a toy block on display, either on the low wall cabinet or on the TV stand.
tasks.instruction_zh: 把积木摆到靠墙矮柜上或电视柜上做展示。

occupied.note: the pot lid and the oatmeal bowl take up the cabinet top: the 15 cm gap between them is too narrow for a block

occupied_block_away.note: the cabinet top is full and the block was left on the dining table

diagnostics: occupants oatmeal bowl + mug + soda can + juice bottle: Clear failed at the mug's rim pinch in the crowd (1/1); three bowls 3 cm apart: Clear failed at the first bowl's rim pinch (1/1) -> two well separated occupants (lid by its knob, bowl by its rim)

alternative_tv_stand.recovery: Place on the cabinet top -> failure (no free spot) -> TV stand

fallback_clear.status: not passed: clear could not pick the occupants off the cabinet top (mug in a crowd 1/1, bowl next to bowls 1/1, oatmeal bowl after the lid was moved 1/1: rim pinch 'not held')
fallback_clear.recovery: Place on the cabinet top -> failure -> set the block down, Clear the top, fetch the block again

hard_search_alt_support.recovery: search the block -> place on the cabinet fails (full) -> TV stand

tasks.instruction: Warm up the leftover oatmeal for breakfast (at least 40 C). When you are done, the stove must be off and the microwave door closed.
tasks.instruction_zh: 把剩下的燕麦粥热一下当早饭（至少 40 度）。做完后灶台要关火，微波炉门要关好。

microwave_broken.note: the microwave runs its cycle but does not heat: the heat call fails on the measured temperature

broken_oatmeal_away.note: the microwave does not heat and the oatmeal was left on the wall cabinet (carried from the dining table it slipped out of the rim pinch, 2/2)

diagnostics: variant 'microwave_occupied' (a bowl of leftovers in the cavity) was dropped: the oatmeal was still inserted in front of it (the cavity holds two bowls front to back), so the condition did not block the microwave route (benchmark/runs/dbg2/T07_heat_oatmeal)

alternative_stove.recovery: Heat in the microwave -> failure (temperature does not rise) -> Stop the microwave, take the oatmeal out, heat it on the stove

hard_search_stove.recovery: search the oatmeal -> heat in the microwave fails -> stop, take it out, stove

tasks.instruction: Wipe down the kitchen island with the sponge after cooking, then leave the sponge on the island.
tasks.instruction_zh: 做完饭用海绵擦一下厨房岛台，擦完把海绵放回岛台上。

sponge_on_island.note: the sponge lies on the island

sponge_on_tv_stand.note: the sponge lies on the TV stand behind the island

far_sponge_tv.note: the robot starts in the dining room; the sponge is on the TV stand

diagnostics: former T08 'chill the soda can in the fridge' moved to diagnostics: the open fridge door drifted below 60 % open before the place (1/2), the can tipped on the shelf (xy err 0.11 m, 1/2; the same failure as k_fridge_chill in verification round 30), and with the can in the dining room the door was pushed shut on the way (2/2)

nominal_from_tv_stand.note: approach the island before wiping; the fallback 'wipe fails -> approach -> wipe' is not used: after the failed wipe the approach parked but its IK check failed (2/2), and navigating to the stove instead did not help (1/1)

hard_search_approach.recovery: search the sponge -> approach the island -> wipe

tasks.instruction: Make tomato soup for lunch: put the cherry tomatoes into the pot on the stove, stir them, cover the pot and heat the soup to 60 C. Turn the stove off afterwards.
tasks.instruction_zh: 午饭做个番茄汤：把小番茄放进灶上的锅里，搅一搅，盖上锅盖，加热到 60 度，然后关火。

lid_on.note: the lid is on the pot

lid_off.note: the lid lies on the stove beside the pot (where uncover sets it aside)

lid_on_spoon_away.note: the lid is on the pot and the spoon was left on the low wall cabinet

diagnostics: lid_off with the lid on the stove's right burner: the lid slipped out of the hand during cover (place_rise), 1/1; on the island next to the pot it was pushed during the stir/spoon place and its pick missed (2/2); at the island's left end it slipped out of the hand on the way to the pot (2/2) -> the spot uncover itself uses (cover passed 2/2 from there)

fallback_uncover.recovery: Collect into the pot -> refused (lid on) -> Uncover -> Collect

hard_uncover_search_spoon.recovery: collect refused (lid) -> uncover -> collect; spoon not on the island -> search

tasks.instruction: Someone left an empty soda can lying around. Throw it into the trash can.
tasks.instruction_zh: 有人随手放了个空易拉罐，把它扔进垃圾桶。

can_on_island.note: the can stands on the island

can_in_dining_room.note: the can stands on the dining table in the next room, out of sight

far_can_far.note: the robot starts in the dining room, the can is on the TV stand

search_first.recovery: Pick refused (can not observed) -> Search -> found on the dining table

hard_explore_search.recovery: pick refused (can not observed) -> search -> explore for the trash can

tasks.instruction: Lunch is over and the apple is still on the dining table. Put it into the fruit basket on the low bookcase in the bedroom; if the basket is not there, the serving tray on the study desk will do.
tasks.instruction_zh: 午饭吃完了，苹果还在餐桌上。把它收进卧室矮书架上的果篮里；果篮不在的话，就放进书桌上的托盘里。

fruits_on_table.note: the apple on the dining table, the basket on the bedroom bookcase

basket_missing.note: no fruit basket on the bookcase: the serving tray on the study desk

alternative_tray.recovery: no basket on the bookcase: place into it fails -> the tray on the desk

tasks.instruction: It is nearly bedtime. Put the kid's toy car and rubber duck away in the storage basket in the bedroom.
tasks.instruction_zh: 快到睡觉时间了，把孩子的玩具小车和小黄鸭收进卧室的储物筐里。

toys_out.note: the car on the living-room floor, the duck on the TV stand

duck_in_study.note: the duck was left on the study desk

explore_search_duck.recovery: the duck is not in the living room -> search the study

tasks.instruction: Set the dining table for breakfast. The spoon is already there; bring a bowl and a cup and put them next to it. A mug is fine if there is no cup.
tasks.instruction_zh: 摆早餐：餐桌上已经放好勺子了，拿一个碗和一个杯子过来，放在勺子旁边。没有杯子的话用马克杯也行。

dishes_on_tv_stand.note: bowl and cup on the living-room TV stand, the spoon on the dining table

no_cup.note: no cup in the house: the mug on the bedroom bookcase

bowl_on_cabinet.note: the bowl was left on the low wall cabinet, out of the first views (dining table, TV stand)

no_cup_bowl_on_cabinet.note: no cup, and the bowl on the low wall cabinet

alternative_mug.recovery: no cup seen; navigate to the cup fails (never observed) -> the mug

explore_search_bowl.recovery: the bowl is not on the TV stand -> search the living room

hard_search_bowl_mug.recovery: neither on the TV stand: search the bowl in the living room, then the mug in the bedroom

tasks.instruction: Someone left their paperback face down on the kitchen island and the spine is getting bent. Turn it face up and leave it on the island for them; they are still reading it.
tasks.instruction_zh: 有人把平装书扣在厨房岛台上了，书脊都快压弯了。帮忙把它翻过来正面朝上，还放在岛台上，他还没看完。

book_free.note: the book lies on the island with free paths to the front edge

book_out_of_view.note: the robot starts at the wall cabinet facing away

tasks.instruction: We are about to make dumplings and the rolling pin has rolled right to the front edge of the island. Roll it back in so it cannot fall off; that also shows whether it rolls smoothly.
tasks.instruction_zh: 准备包饺子了，擀面杖滚到岛台前沿快掉下去了。把它往里滚回去别让它掉下来，顺便看看滚得顺不顺。

pin_free.note: the pin lies 3 mm from the island's front edge with room behind it

pin_out_of_view.note: the robot starts at the wall cabinet facing away

tasks.instruction: We are playing hide-and-seek with the kid's toy block: hide the wooden block in the empty pot on the stove and put the lid on so they cannot see it.
tasks.instruction_zh: 陪孩子玩藏东西的游戏：把木积木藏进灶台上的空锅里，再盖好锅盖，别让孩子一眼看到。

lid_off.note: the lid lies on the stove beside the pot

lid_on.note: the lid is on the pot: hide is refused until the pot is uncovered

block_crowded.note: the lid lies beside the pot; the block is boxed in by the oatmeal bowl and the rolling pin (3 mm, T02's crowd)

lid_on_crowded.note: the lid is on the pot and the block is boxed in

far_lid_on.note: the robot starts at the wall cabinet facing away; the lid is on the pot

fallback_separate.recovery: Hide fails (its pick of the block fails) -> Separate -> Hide

hard_uncover_separate.recovery: Hide refused (lid) -> Uncover; Hide fails (pick) -> Separate -> Hide

hard_search_uncover.recovery: search the block and the pot -> Hide refused (lid) -> Uncover -> Hide

tasks.instruction: Grandma wants to know whether there is still a clean plate and bowl in the low wall cabinet for dinner. Have a look inside and close the cabinet door properly afterwards.
tasks.instruction_zh: 奶奶想知道靠墙矮柜里还有没有干净的盘子和碗，晚饭要用。去看一眼里面，看完把柜门关好。

at_island.note: the robot starts at its default spot in front of the island

tasks.instruction: Movie night is over. The empty soda can is still on the TV stand and the foam packing cube from the delivery lies on the living-room floor; take both to the wide storage bin we use for recycling. It is usually on the low bookcase in the bedroom.
tasks.instruction_zh: 电影看完了，空易拉罐还在电视柜上，快递里的泡沫块掉在客厅地上。把它们都放进平时当回收箱用的宽储物箱，它一般在卧室的矮书架上。

bin_on_bookcase.note: can on the TV stand, cube on the floor, the bin on the bedroom low bookcase

tasks.instruction: Someone took the juice bottle off the breakfast table and left it somewhere. Put it back on the dining table, standing up.
tasks.instruction_zh: 有人把早餐桌上的果汁瓶拿走随手放下了。把它放回餐桌上，立着放。

bottle_on_cabinet.note: the bottle on the low wall cabinet top

tasks.instruction: The kid finished reading and left the red book on the study desk. Put it back on the low bookcase in the bedroom.
tasks.instruction_zh: 孩子看完书，把红色的书留在了书桌上。把它放回卧室的矮书架上。

book_on_desk.note: the red book flat on the desk, no overhang (pick fails: edge pinch overhang -0.025 m, s10, v3_round8)

fallback_expose.recovery: Pick fails (flat book, no overhang) -> Expose -> Pick

tasks.instruction: Greet the person by the fridge, then return to the home posture.
Find out what is on the island and explore the living room.
Roll the rolling pin, pull it toward you and centre it on the island.
Lay the juice bottle down, then stand it up again.
Turn the paperback book over on the island.
Hand the rolling pin to the left hand and open and close the low cabinet while holding it.
Show a wooden block to the camera, then steady the mug with the left hand.
Square one block with the island, then stack the other on it rotated and touch it.
Sweep the two wooden blocks together, then push one aside.
Put the mug on the stove, switch the burner on for a few seconds and off again.
Knock on the low cabinet, look inside, open it and close it again.
Heat the oatmeal in the microwave with its start key, then stop the microwave.
Move a block to the stove, put it back where it was, then swap it with the soda can.
Group two blocks and the can on the island, then sort the can into the trash and a block onto the stove.
Empty the mug of tomatoes into the pot.
Pour the tomatoes from the mug into the pot.
Taste the soup: lift the spoon, lower it again, then dip it into the open pot.
Hide a wooden block in the pot under its lid.
Clear the top of the low wall cabinet onto the kitchen island.
The leftover oatmeal went into the fridge still warm: check it and chill it to 8 C; leave the fridge closed.
Pick the wooden block up from the floor and put it on the island.
